integrity.claim_basis: Exact deterministic phase flow and Poisson reset-age pushforward; sign classification from the exact logarithmic derivative; explicit asymptotic expansions.
integrity.computational_status: 97 deterministic numerical diagnostic checks pass using verify.py; finite numerical experiments are not proofs.
integrity.source_status: Primary open-access full text of arxiv:2203.00339 and text of arxiv:2402.14921 inspected; broader indexed coverage and publisher-access limitations disclosed.

scientific_limitations: Positive detuning and coupling; full simultaneous rate-r Poisson phase resetting to a common zero phase; no between-reset phase diffusion.
Results concern physical-time stationary relative-phase density and its interior modes and locking-edge regularity, not macroscopic many-body synchronization or individual absolute phases.
General age-pushforward methodology is prior work; model-specific complete Adler morphology and nonhyperbolic edge classification are the contribution.
Publication priority remains subject to potentially unindexed equivalences; an independent scientific audit has not been performed.
title: Exact mode and edge transitions of the Poisson-reset Adler phase
